|url=http://www.chicagobooth.edu/news/daa2006/01-rao.aspx |title= (Jerry) Rao: 2006 Distinguished Entrepreneurial Alumni Award Winner |publisher=Chicagobooth.edu |access-date=2010-08-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100528133231/http://www.chicagobooth.edu/news/daa2006/01-rao.aspx |archive-date=28 May 2010 |url-status=dead}}{{Cite news |date=2022-09-30 |title=Leeds: Indian tech firm to create 1,000 jobs in city |language=en-GB |work=BBC News |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-leeds-63076475 |access-date=2023-08-06}} The company provides infrastructure technology and applications outsourcing services, as well as architecture guidance, application development and integration, and application management services. It serves financial services, telecom, logistics, and technology industries. Mphasis was ranked #7 in Indian IT companies and overall #189 by [[Fortune India 500]] in 2019.{{Cite web |title=Fortune India 500 2019: This Year's Top Performing Companies |url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/rankings/fortune-500/2019 |access-date=2026-01-24 |website=Fortune India |language=en}} In April 2016, [[Hewlett Packard Enterprise]] sold the majority of its stake in Mphasis to [[Blackstone Group]] LP for around [[US$]]1 billion.{{cite web | url=https://www.blackstone.com/media/press-releases/article/blackstone-to-acquire-a-majority-stake-in-mphasis | title=Press Releases Archives | date=17 May 2023 }} ==History== [[File:Mphasis - Unlease the Next.jpg|thumb|Old logo of Mphasis]] ===Formation and early years=== Mphasis was formed in June 2000 after the merger of the US-based IT consulting company Mphasis Corporation (founded in 1998 in [[Santa Monica]] by [[Jerry Rao]]{{cite web |url=http://www.chicagobooth.edu/news/daa2006/01-rao.aspx |title= (Jerry) Rao: 2006 Distinguished Entrepreneurial Alumni Award Winner |publisher=Chicagobooth.edu |access-date=2010-08-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100528133231/http://www.chicagobooth.edu/news/daa2006/01-rao.aspx |archive-date=28 May 2010 |url-status=dead}} and Jeroen Tas.[http://investing.businessweek.com/research/stocks/private/person.asp?personId=924875 Jeroen Tas: Executive Profile and Biography - Business Week]{{dead link|date=April 2023|bot=medic}}{{cbignore|bot=medic}}) and the Indian IT services company BFL Software Limited (founded in 1992).{{cite web|url=http://www.moneycontrol.com/company-facts/mphasis/history/MB02 |title=Company History of Mphasis |publisher=Moneycontrol.com |access-date=2010-08-19}} In June 2006 [[Electronic Data Systems]] (EDS) purchased a controlling stake in the company (42%) for $380 million and operated the company as an independent EDS unit.[http://www.business-standard.com/india/news/eds-acquires-majority-stake-in-mphasis/1706/on EDS acquires majority stake in Mphasis] ===As a Hewlett-Packard company=== On 13 May 2008, [[Hewlett-Packard]] confirmed that it had reached a deal with Electronic Data Systems and Magnetic System to acquire the company for $13.9 billion.[http://news.smh.com.au/world/hp-to-buy-eds-for-139-bln-dlrs-to-expand-services-20080514-2e2f.html HP to buy EDS for 13.9 Billion US Dollars, to expand services] The deal was completed on 26 August 2008. In September 2009, Mphasis changed its brand identity by dropping EDS association to become "Mphasis, an HP Company" after HP retired EDS Brand to become "[[HP Enterprise Services]]". Mphasis operated as an independent HP subsidiary with its own board and continued to be listed on Indian markets as "Mphasis Limited".{{cite web |url=http://mphasis.com/pdfs/BrandingIdentity.pdf |title=Mphasis become HP Company|access-date=2010-08-19 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101126084452/http://mphasis.com/pdfs/BrandingIdentity.pdf |archive-date=26 November 2010}} HP owned close to 62% in Mphasis and Mphasis got around 50% of its revenues from HP.[http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/ites/tough-time-ahead-for-mphasis-as-hewlett-packard-cut-its-sales-forecast/articleshow/16727352.cms Tough time ahead for Mphasis as Hewlett Packard cut its sales forecast] Mphasis marked $1 billion in revenues and registered a consolidated revenue of RS 50.37 billion ($1,099.3 million) for the year ended 31 October 2010 becoming the sixth Indian IT company to do that.{{cite news |url=http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2010-11-23/news/27592381_1_mphasis-revenue-mark-net-profit |title=Mphasis crosses $1 billion revenue mark, PAT up 20% |work=The Times of India |date=23 November 2010 |access-date=23 June 2011 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20120710070020/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2010-11-23/news/27592381_1_mphasis-revenue-mark-net-profit |archive-date=10 July 2012 |url-status=dead}} In February 2014, Mphasis changed its logo and the brand name as Mphasis Unleash the Next, seeking to boost business other than from parent [[Hewlett-Packard]], its largest client.{{cite web |title=MphasiS unveils new brand identity |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/info-tech/mphasis-unveils-new-brand-identity/article20722290.ece1 |website=Businessline |date=5 February 2014 |language=en}} On 30 June 2015, Mphasis announced the signing of a definitive agreement to transfer a significant portion of its domestic business, to [[Hinduja Global Solutions]] (HGS). On 10 July 2015, Mphasis announced it will move 2,000 employees to Karvy Data Management Services Ltd (KDMSL) as part of a deal signed to partially sell its domestic outsourcing business to Karvy.{{citation needed|date=November 2020}} ===Under Blackstone Group=== In 2016, after Hewlett-Packard announced plans to sell its controlling stakes in Mphasis, three companies [[Tech Mahindra]], [[Apollo Global Management]] and [[Blackstone Group]] entered the race to acquire Mphasis. Tech Mahindra emerged as the frontrunner{{cite news|title=Tech Mahindra leads race to buy Mphasis|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tech/tech-news/TechM-leads-race-to-buy-Mphasis/articleshow/51283351.cms|access-date=27 April 2016|work=The Times of India}} before it decided to pull out in order to avoid a bidding war with other companies.{{cite news|title=Tech Mahindra pulls out of race to acquire Mphasis|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/tech-mahindra-pulls-out-of-race-to-acquire-mphasis-116030900567_1.html|access-date=27 April 2016|work=Business Standard}} Later that year, Blackstone acquired Hewlett-Packard's 60.17% stake in Mphasis for {{INR}}5,466 crore ($815 million); Blackstone's subsequent [[tender offer|open offer]] to acquire an additional 26% from public shareholders failed.{{cite news|title=Blackstone buys control of Mphasis|url=http://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/blackstone-india-to-acquire-majority-stake-in-mphasis-in-a-upto-11-billion-deal/article8432367.ece|access-date=27 April 2016|work=The Hindu}}{{cite news |title=Blackstone's open offer for Mphasis fails; ends with 60% stake |url=https://www.vccircle.com/blackstone-s-open-offer-mphasis-fails-ends-60-stake |access-date=10 June 2024 |work=VCCircle}} On 29 January 2017, [[Nitin Rakesh]] joined Mphasis as the [[chief executive officer]] and director.{{cite news|title=Mphasis was a jewel hidden in the HP family: new CEO|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/mphasis-was-a-jewel-hidden-in-the-hp-family-new-ceo/articleshow/56871405.cms|website=The Times of India}} On 7 Aug 2018, the Mphasis Board announced a buyback offer for its shareholders at an approximate premium of 17.4%.{{cite web |title=Mphasis buyback offer opens today |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/mphasis-buyback-offer-opens-today/article25681908.ece |website=Businessline |date=7 December 2018 |language=en}} In April 2021, Blackstone committed up to $2.8 billion to acquire controlling stake in Mphasis. A wholly owned subsidiary of the [[Abu Dhabi Investment Authority]] (ADIA), UC Investments and other long-term investors will be co-investing along with Blackstone.{{cite news |title=Blackstone, other investors commit up to $2.8 billion to acquire controlling stake in Mphasis extract: Mphasis Limited is an Indian multinational information technology service and consulting company based in Bengaluru. The company provides infrastructure technology and applications outsourcing services, as well as architecture guidance, application development and integration, and application management services. It serves financial services, telecom, logistics, and technology industries. Mphasis was ranked #7 in Indian IT companies and overall #189 by Fortune India 500 in 2019. In April 2016, Hewlett Packard Enterprise sold the majority of its stake in Mphasis to Blackstone Group LP for around US$1 billion.
